svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 406 x 330 from 25 mm XPS. It covers the opening with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 to spare each side and stays inside the latches.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face the front with white self-adhesive vinyl so it lasts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle: print in PETG a flange 120 x 30 x 4 with two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 x 12 posts and a 100 long, 12 x 12 grip standing 25 out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue the flange to the front with foam-safe adhesive,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred left to right, its centre 30 below the top edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stick four hook-and-loop pads on its back, 30 in from each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner, and their mates on the door.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: presses flat on the front of the door, 4 clear of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: keepers and latch hooks. Fitted for the 40 C, 85 % point and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for cold points; off for the others.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it stays on with the rig running and peels off by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hand with the pull handle; the handle does not move.
